<b>Ministers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are winged, high ranked disciples of [[the Choir]] made aggressive by the [[Haunting]].<ref>Minister [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Gold ranked disciple of the Choir and direct servant to the Citadel's Conductors."</i></ref><ref>Minister [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"The lethality of these bugs is unexpected. Their bodies were never built for combat. The Haunting has altered their nature dramatically."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Ministers can often be found sitting on the floor or clinging to walls, and pursue [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] within a radius around their spawn area.<br>
Being flying enemies, Ministers attempt to keep aerial distance from Hornet before closing in to attack. They have three moves:
* <b>Slice Barrage:</b> Rears its head back, then darts towards Hornet whilst headbutting at her wildly, comboing Hornet for {{Damage|1+1}} if she is caught at any point during the attack.
* <b>Parry Strike:</b> The Minister assumes a parry stance with a glinting sound effect. If Hornet hits the Minister while it is in this stance, it takes no damage and performs a large swooping headbutt at Hornet.
* <b>Evade:</b> Performs an aerial dash backwards and away from Hornet, often used after an attack and if Hornet is close to it. 

Ministers are immune to the venom effect of the [[Pollip Pouch]]. They parry or evade any careless attack, so letting them strike first and then using [[Cross Stitch]] may be a safer option. Additionally, as with many other melee flying enemies, [[Needle#Needle-bouncing|Needle-bouncing]] and attacking from below work well against Ministers, as they cannot defend themselves from these directions.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-threaded]] Ministers have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

{{SS Needolin|columns=2|

== Location ==
Ministers can be found throughout the [[High Halls]], and four of them are fought as part of the [[Enemy_Gauntlets_(Silksong)/High_Halls 1|enemy gauntlet]] in [[the Forum]]. Upon returning to the arena in [[Act 3]], one [[black-threaded]] Minister can be found there alongside a [[Choir Clapper]], and does not respawn after being defeated.
